summary.text: Thomas Paolino is a Republican state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 17 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Paolino was assigned to the Senate Education Committee and the Senate Finance Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
He advanced from the Republican primary for District 17 on September 9, 2026, and is on the ballot in the November 3 general election.
